text.name: Arms Control Unravels
text.rules: Record "treaties lapse". Until the end of this turn, points spent by either side count 1 more.
text.history: The United States withdrew from the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty on 2 August 2019 and from the Open Skies Treaty on 22 November 2020; the New START treaty, the last US-Russia limit on strategic nuclear weapons, expired on 5 February 2026.
